title: Manimuthu Retains Girls' Singles Crown, Dattu Wins Boys' Title
indian_angle: Indian youngsters Manimuthu and Dattu secured national titles, highlighting emerging talent in Indian badminton.
summary: Manimuthu successfully defended her girls' singles title, while Dattu claimed the boys' singles crown at the national championships.

title: Satwik-Chirag Fall in Hong Kong Open Semifinals
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, reached the semifinals of a Super 500 event.
summary: World No. 6 Indian pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty were defeated 18-21, 19-21 in the semifinals of the Hong Kong Open.

title: Abhay Singh, Akanksha Salunkhe Crowned Squash National Champions
indian_angle: Abhay Singh and Akanksha Salunkhe, prominent Indian squash players, secured national titles.
summary: Abhay Singh and qualifier Akanksha Salunkhe clinched the men's and women's singles titles respectively at the National Squash Championships.

title: Gukesh Aims to Win World Chess Title Again
indian_angle: Indian prodigy Gukesh is set to defend his World Chess Championship title, aiming for another victory.
summary: Indian chess sensation Gukesh expressed his determination to win the World Chess Championship again, rather than just defend his title, after becoming the youngest champion in 2024.
